description_sq:
Vila ndodhet ne Ibe, prane Shkolles "Vahid Haka;.
Siperfaqe totale banimi 500 m2.
E organizuar ne 2 kate, secili prej kateve siperfaqe 250 m2.
Ambienti i katit te 1 shfrytezohen per biznes, Market,biznesi i cili funksionon ne nje hark kohor te gjate mbi 15 vite, me nje xhiro te konsiderueshme.

Vila eshte banueshme dhe e mirembajtur, me nje investim komfort.
Per detaje shtese mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni!
description_en: The villa is located in Ibe, near the "Vahid Haka" School. Total living area 500 m2. Organized in 2 floors, each of the floors 250 m2. The environment of the 1st floor is used for business, Market, the business which has been operating for a long period of time over 15 years, with a significant turnover. The environment of the 2nd floor is used for living, organized in 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and a substantial balcony. The villa is habitable and well maintained, with a comfortable investment. For additional details, do not hesitate to contact us!
